spec: parse_date(s: str) -> datetime: parse ISO8601. Must handle YYYY-MM-DD, YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS, YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ (UTC), YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS+HH:MM. Return aware datetime (UTC if Z, else given tz). Naive dates assumed UTC. Reject invalid month/day. Leap-year aware.
merge_intervals(intervals: list[list[int]]) -> list[list[int]]: sort intervals, merge overlapping/touching ([1,3]+[3,5]->[1,5]), handle empty, preserve input (no mutation).

retry(max_retries=3, delay=0.0, exceptions=(Exception,)): decorator retrying up to max_retries+1 total attempts, only on given exceptions, sleep delay between retries, re-raise last exception, preserve metadata, handle max_retries=0, do not swallow non-matching exceptions.

transfer(accounts: dict[str,int], frm: str, to: str, amount: int): amount>0 else ValueError; frm/to must exist else KeyError; frm must have funds else ValueError atomic (no partial debit); no self-transfer (ValueError); ints only.

top_k_frequent(nums: list[int], k: int) -> list[int]: k most frequent, tie-break smaller number first, sorted by (-freq, value), k in [1, len(set(nums))] else ValueError if nums empty or k out of range, deterministic, handle negatives, return exactly k.
